sources.title: 3D Vision & Scene Understanding | zhaoyang97/Paper-Notes | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This section covers the 3D vision research domain across major conferences (AAAI 2026, CVPR 2026, ICLR 2026). The repository documents a vast collection of notes, including 751 from CVPR 2026 and 196 from ICLR 2026, focusing on the transition from static 3D reconstruction to dynamic 4D modeling, neural rendering, and robust point cloud understanding.
